summary:
I've been building a lot of infrastructure lately, but three things feel worth calling out.

I shipped a personal RSVP reader called Cadence — it tails a live Claude Code session transcript and flashes the reply one phrase at a time, with adaptive pacing driven by a Haiku-based density scorer. The interesting engineering problem was credential resolution: the tool needs to call the Anthropic API, and on my machine the only credential present is the Claude Code OAuth token, not a traditional API key. Getting that to work as a Bearer token with the right beta header took some digging, and the result is somewhere in gray-area territory — it works, but it's not officially supported.

BudgetTracker got a lot of work. The database moved off a shared MSSQL instance onto Postgres on Supabase — a full Drizzle ORM rewrite rather than a compatibility shim, since it was a good window for breaking changes with only one user. On top of that, I added multi-provider LLM support so the in-app AI assistant can route to Anthropic, OpenAI, or a local model depending on what the user has configured. The trickiest part was the access boundary work: a native tool-calling loop where the server injects the userId before any tool executes, so the assistant can only ever see accounts the requesting user is entitled to see. Eight thousand-plus transactions, 773 merchants, all migrated without data loss.

The D&D campaign hub got a meaningful chunk of RAG work. The pgvector embedding column had been silently dropped by a Prisma migration and never restored, so search had been returning empty for a while without anyone noticing. I fixed the column, switched from ivfflat to an HNSW index, and added a pre-push hook to reject any future migration that tries to drop it again. Phase 1 of the memory system is fully implemented — session note chunking, per-author chat indexing, a three-tier trust model for what the AI can surface to whom — but it's sitting on a branch waiting for Ben to apply the migrations to production.

highlights.oneLiner: Migrated DB from MSSQL to Postgres/Supabase with a full Drizzle ORM rewrite, added multi-provider LLM support, and shipped a native tool-calling loop with server-side access boundaries
D&D campaign hub RAG work: restored dropped pgvector column, switched to HNSW index, added pre-push guard, and implemented Phase 1 memory system across a branch awaiting prod migration
Built Cadence RSVP speed-reader with Haiku adaptive pacing and gray-area Claude Code OAuth credential path for the Anthropic API
